descriptionChirho: The proper noun designating Ebed (meaning 'servant'), a personal name borne by at least two individuals in the Hebrew Bible: (1) the father of Gaal who opposed Abimelech at Shechem (Judg 9:26-35), and (2) a family head who returned from Babylonian exile with Ezra (Ezra 8:6). All 6 occurrences refer to persons bearing this same name. The two clusters differ only in minor transliteration (eng 'Ebed' vs 'Eved', spa 'Ébed' vs 'Eved') but the underlying Hebrew form is identical. Multilingual evidence: arb 'عَبَد', swa 'Ebedi', hin 'एबेद', kor '에베드 / 에벳'.
